title: Spin-orbit correlation of quarks within quarkonium
summary: The spin-orbit correlation (SOC) provides a unique probe into the internal spin structure of hadrons. Defined via the parity-odd (P-odd) energy-momentum tensor (EMT), this observable can remain non-vanishing even in systems where the total angular momentum is zero. In this study, we connect the formal field-theoretical definition of the SOC to a non-perturbative quantum many-body framework utilizing light-front dynamics.
